summary:
We choose this project because we wanna make gaming fun and as well as educational
We observed many kids around us playing onilne moble games and not letting the phone go from there hand even for a secound . I even saw my niece who was only like 7yrs old  playing some space game so i asked her if she likes the space she exictedly said yes . So I and my team  just wanted to create a simple game for her to play
details: This a space themed game . This game is designed for the kids of ages 10years below . In this game there is a character which moves around the space ship solving various problems and there are also some quiz where the kids can learn from. this game is not that complicated and very user friendly
